reviews.title: Not for large projects
reviews.text:
While I like the software is great for smaller charts, it's an absolute pain if you're trying to use it for large charts (like a c2c chart).

There is no hand exclusion, so when you go to zoom in/out (or even just move around in the chart), you end up drawing random cells.

There is no way to select and move cells without cut/pasting them. This would be okay - I guess - if the selection tool didn't work in the least helpful way possible.

You have to select the exact dimensions of the area you copied or cut if you want it to paste correctly - else it cuts off edges. You can move your selection box around, which helps mitigate this, but if you have to move to a different area of the chart or zoom in/out, the selection box often disappeared (ref back to poor hand exclusion).

Also, if your selection box is less than a 5x5 grid, you often cannot move it without changing the size of the selection.

Also also, if you try to precisely move a selection box, it will take that holding down on the selection and will open a menu for changing the color of the stitches in the selection. This is infinitely irritating.

You can flip/mirror stitches around both x and y axis, but there is no way to rotate them 90° (but you can rotate the chart 90°, but you still have to redraw the object you want in that orientation).

I paid for the pro version, and I really wanted to like this app. But it’s just very frustrating to use for what I need it for.

reviews.title: Instantly hard to use
reviews.text: Is this an app? A document? When I open the app my saved files open on my phone. When I go to make a chart the lines I entered are being doubled. The chart doesn’t start with row 1 but with the total number of rows I want. I want to start with stitch 1 and then go to stitch 2, not start from stitch 26.

Paid to use the non mirror feature , only works some of the time

reviews.title: Not for designers
reviews.text:
Written instructions do not work correctly for right side/wrong side when switching from flat to in the round. They read from left to right instead of right to left, but knits and purls are not reversed. 

This was a waste of money.

reviews.title: Opens Automatically
reviews.text: Whenever I open my files on my iPad, the app opens automatically and I am not using the app. I have to remove the app to open my files. Sorry I paid for the pro version.
